in_marathi.name: Bhanu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhanu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bha' which means 'light' and 'nu' which means 'new'. This name is associated with the Sun God, Surya, and signifies the light of knowledge and consciousness. It is believed that the name Bhanu bestows wisdom, courage, and strength upon the bearer.
